LibreChurch Stack

A shared home for church life.

Bible study, church community, and service presentation. LibreChurch Stack brings Heritage Bible, Heritage Community, and SyncShow together.

Explore the stack ↗

Study with Heritage Bible

Read Scripture, compare translations, and keep personal notes at the Bible side of the stack.

Organize your community

Host church resources, invite members, share events, collect RSVPs, and export calendars with Heritage Community.

Present with SyncShow

Prepare a service and run coordinated screens, connected to your church’s own community server.

This is the public project site. Each church runs its own community; there is no shared member sign-in here.
